summary: UK demand is turning to Christmas: personalised gifts (name baubles, stocking tags) are Etsy UK's strongest gifting category and UK searches peak from October to mid-December, so get Christmas listings live by 30 Oct. Year-round, print-in-place articulated animals and fidget toys keep leading downloads and TikTok views — plan a Black Friday bundle of them by 6 Nov.

trending.name: Personalised Christmas ornaments & name tags
trending.why: Etsy UK's Christmas gift-trend pages are led by personalised items (custom ornaments, stocking and gift name tags), many priced under £15. UK Christmas searches run from September to about 15 December, peaking from October.
trending.printNotes: Ideal for the K2 Plus in two colours (name in contrast). Small, fast prints — good margin per gram.

sources.title: What sells best on Etsy in 2026 (UK forecast)

trending.name: Articulated print-in-place animals
trending.why: Etsy UK's best-selling 3D-printed pages are full of articulated animals (dragons, axolotls, cats, sharks) with hundreds to thousands of reviews. The articulated dragon still leads MakerWorld and Printables download counts in 2026.
trending.printNotes: Print-in-place in silk or multi-colour PLA. Many popular designs are non-commercial — buy the designer's commercial licence or design your own.

sources.title: Etsy UK — best selling 3D printed items

trending.name: Planters & vases
trending.why: Planter designs and planter bundles appear repeatedly on Etsy UK's 3D-printing bestseller pages; vases and planters are consistently listed among the best-selling home-décor prints.
trending.printNotes: Use PETG for anything holding water or soil. Vase mode prints fast on both printers.

trending.name: Modern & lithophane lamps
trending.why: Modern lamp designs are among the most-listed items on Etsy UK's 3D-print bestseller pages; lithophane lamps and snowflake lithophanes are popular personalised gifts in winter.
trending.printNotes: Needs a cheap LED/lamp kit (easy to buy). White PLA for lithophanes.

sources.title: Etsy UK — best selling items 3D print

trending.name: Tabletop gaming accessories
trending.why: eBay's 3D-printed best sellers skew to hobbyists and collectors: tabletop miniatures, dice towers, card boxes and board-game insert organisers.
trending.printNotes: Avoid branded game names/logos. Insert organisers for popular games sell well but must not copy trademarked artwork.

trending.name: Fidget toys (gear spinners, infinity cubes)
trending.why: #1 on a TikTok trend list updated 5 Oct 2026 (943K views for 3D-printed fidget toys; gear fidget spinners 673K). The infinity cube is described as the most-printed fidget worldwide.
trending.printNotes: Small, fast, cheap to make — good for bundles and market stalls. Check each design's licence.

sources.title: VelocitySpy — trending 3D printing products on TikTok (5 Oct 2026)

trending.name: Desk & gaming setup accessories
trending.why: Rising on TikTok (Oct 2026): game controller stands (28K views), under-desk cup holders (14K) and joystick desk toys (329K). Desk 'buddies' such as highland-cow monitor figures are shown as sellers' best sellers.
trending.printNotes: PETG for clamps and holders that take load. Good Christmas gifts for gamers.

sources.title: VelocitySpy — trending 3D printing products on TikTok (5 Oct 2026)

trending.name: 3D printed cat beds
trending.why: Rising on TikTok in the 5 Oct 2026 snapshot with 404K views.
trending.printNotes: Large print — best on the K2 Plus (350 mm). Long print time, so price for the hours.

sources.title: VelocitySpy — trending 3D printing products on TikTok (5 Oct 2026)

trending.name: Comic book wall display frames
trending.why: '3D printed comic book wall art' had 657K TikTok views in the 5 Oct 2026 snapshot.
trending.printNotes: Sell the frame/display only — no comic characters or logos on the print.

sources.title: VelocitySpy — trending 3D printing products on TikTok (5 Oct 2026)

trending.name: Character planters & fan models (Pokémon etc.)
trending.why: Pokémon planter packs and Charizard model kits appear on Etsy UK and eBay UK, but they use trademarked characters.
trending.printNotes: Not recommended — selling prints of trademarked characters risks takedowns and legal claims. Listed only so you know why it's excluded.

sources.title: Etsy UK — best selling 3D printed items

ideas.title: Personalised name bauble
ideas.description: Flat or dome bauble with a raised name in a contrasting colour, sold singly or as family sets. Top Christmas gifting search on Etsy UK.
ideas.designSource: Design it yourself — a simple shape with text; offer fonts and colour choices.
ideas.why: Etsy UK's Christmas trend pages lead with personalised ornaments, many under £15; UK searches peak Oct–mid Dec.

ideas.title: Stocking & gift name tags
ideas.description: Personalised tags that clip onto stockings or tie onto presents. Cheap to make, easy add-on sale.
ideas.why: Personalised stocking and gift tags feature on Etsy UK's 2026 Christmas pages.

ideas.title: Lithophane photo bauble with LED
ideas.description: Ball or disc lithophane showing the customer's own photo, lit by a small LED. Premium personalised gift.
ideas.designSource: Generate from the customer's photo with a lithophane tool (e.g. ItsLitho — check its terms for commercial use).
ideas.why: UK competitors mostly sell printed glass or ceramic photo baubles at £8–13; a lit lithophane stands out at a higher price.

ideas.title: Articulated dragon (silk PLA)
ideas.description: Print-in-place flexible dragon — a consistent best seller as a gift and stocking filler.
ideas.designSource: Popular dragon designs usually need a commercial licence from the designer (often a small monthly fee) — buy one, or design your own.
ideas.why: Articulated animals fill Etsy UK's bestseller pages and the dragon still leads 2026 download counts.

ideas.title: Fidget pack: gear spinner + infinity cube
ideas.description: Two or three small fidgets sold as a bundle — great for market stalls and as a Black Friday deal.
ideas.designSource: Use designs whose licence allows commercial use (check each one), or design your own.
ideas.why: Fidget toys are #1 on TikTok's 3D-printing trend list (5 Oct 2026); gear spinners 673K views.

ideas.title: Articulated mini animals — set of 3
ideas.description: Three small print-in-place animals in different colours, sold as a discounted bundle.
ideas.designSource: Licensed commercial designs or your own.
ideas.why: Bundles of proven best sellers convert well during Black Friday sales.

ideas.title: Diya tealight holder
ideas.description: Lattice-pattern diya-style holder for LED tealights. Listing window is now — best for local adverts and markets.
ideas.why: Diwali (8 Nov) is a growing UK gifting date; printed decorations are a natural fit. Sell with LED tealights only — plastic and flames don't mix.

ideas.title: Autumn lantern with cut-out pattern
ideas.description: Lantern with leaf or star cut-outs for an LED candle — works for Bonfire Night and as autumn décor.
ideas.why: Seasonal décor sells around Halloween and Bonfire Night; use LED candles only.

ideas.title: Highland cow desk buddy
ideas.description: Small multi-colour desk or monitor figure — a popular low-cost gift.
ideas.designSource: Popular versions are often non-commercial — design your own or license one.
ideas.why: Highland-cow monitor buddies and desk companions appear as sellers' best sellers on TikTok Shop.

ideas.title: Game controller stand
ideas.description: Stand for one or two controllers, in the buyer's choice of colours. Strong gift for gamers.
ideas.designSource: Design it yourself — no console brand logos.

ideas.title: Under-desk cup & headphone holder
ideas.description: Clamp-on holder that swings out from under a desk.
ideas.designSource: Design it yourself, or a model whose licence allows selling.

ideas.title: Self-watering planter
ideas.description: Two-part planter with a water reservoir — evergreen home-décor seller and Christmas gift.
ideas.designSource: Design it yourself or a commercially licensed model.
ideas.why: Planters recur on Etsy UK's 3D-printing bestseller pages.

ideas.title: Dice tower & card deck box
ideas.description: Two-colour dice tower or deck box for tabletop gamers.
ideas.designSource: Design it yourself — avoid game brand names and artwork.
ideas.why: Tabletop accessories are a top eBay category for 3D-printed goods (collectors and hobbyists).

ideas.title: Comic book wall frame
ideas.description: Wall-mounted frame that displays a comic and lets it be swapped. Sell the frame only.
ideas.why: 'Comic book wall art' had 657K TikTok views (Oct 2026).

ideas.title: Modular cat bed
ideas.description: Raised cat bed printed in sections, with a cushion bought separately.
ideas.designSource: Design it yourself or a commercially licensed model.
ideas.why: Rising on TikTok with 404K views (Oct 2026). Only the K2 Plus fits it in one piece.

ideas.title: Dreidel set
ideas.why: Niche but easy seasonal product for Hanukkah (from 5 Dec).
